messages:
Elena (CISO): Thanks everyone for the great all-hands. A few follow-ups on the security/compliance Q&A thread — summarizing and asking for owners.
Matt (CEO): Really appreciate the questions. Quick ask: can leads give target dates where possible? :eyes:  
Devon (eng-security): +1. I'll own a short tech note on VPC private deploys and audit log flow. ETA EOD Wed.
Priya (product): For Dedicated/Private customers, do we need a product toggle for extra audit retention?
Elena (CISO): Yes, Priya — product toggle for retention + a documented privacy impact note. Can you pair with Sam?
Sam (privacy): Happy to. Also need clarity on default retention windows (we heard 90 vs 365 days in the meeting).
Jordan (audits): SOC2 auditor asked for an evidence bundle for KMS BYOK tests and key rotation logs. We should compile by the readiness demo next week.
Devon (eng-security): For BYOK we wrote a short runbook last quarter. I'll attach the repo link in #eng-security, but summary: customer KMS wrapped keys, rotation events logged to audit-cluster.
Elena (CISO): Can someone confirm the current automated export path for audit logs (S3 location + retention policy)?
ops-bot: Automated export job 'audit-export-v2' last run 1965429000. S3 prefix: s3://redwood-audit-exports/prod/. Retention: lifecycle 365 days.
Devon (eng-security): Confirmed. The infra job sets lifecycle 365 by default, but we can param it per-customer for Dedicated/Private.
Priya (product): Action: add product toggle + UI copy for 'Extended Audit Retention' by next sprint. Owner: Priya.
Sam (privacy): Action: propose default retention policy (90 day vs 365 day tradeoffs) and draft data minimization language. Owner: Sam. Due: Fri.
Jordan (audits): Action: assemble SOC2 evidence zip (KMS policies, rotation logs, VPC peering audit). Owner: Jordan + Devon. Due: next Tue.
Matt (CEO): High level: we need clear comms for customers who ask for BYOK evidence. Templates?
Elena (CISO): I'll draft a customer-facing FAQ + evidence checklist. Will post in this thread when done.
Devon (eng-security): Quick config snippet for retention we use internally:
```
# set retention days
LOG_RETENTION_DAYS=365
./scripts/set-audit-lifecycle --prefix prod/ --days $LOG_RETENTION_DAYS
```
Priya (product): (cc @Devon) can that script be parameterized per-customer for Dedicated?
Devon (eng-security): Yes. We already support --prefix and --days flags. Need product + infra to wire the toggle to the job.
Sam (privacy): Note: for EU customers we may need to keep logs in-region. Owner: Ops/Infra to confirm cross-region policy.
ops-bot: Ticket created: #INFRA-4123 "Per-customer audit export region/retention" assigned to infra oncall.
Jordan (audits): One more ask: please keep raw key rotation events (not redacted) in the auditor bundle; we can redact for customer-facing docs.
Elena (CISO): Agreed. Audit bundle should be unredacted, stored in a secure evidence bucket with limited ACLs.
Matt (CEO): Thanks. If we can have the concrete owners/dates (Priya, Sam, Jordan+Devon, Infra) posted here by EOD, I'll relay to the board.
Devon (eng-security): Posting owners/dates now: Devon - tech note (EOD Wed). Priya - product toggle (sprint start + PR by next Fri). Sam - retention policy proposal (Fri). Jordan+Devon - SOC2 evidence bundle (next Tue). Infra - confirm region/retention ticket (#INFRA-4123) progress by Mon.
Elena (CISO): I'll follow up with a short meeting invite with the owners to lock down acceptance criteria.
Priya (product): :+1:
Sam (privacy): Thanks all — will share initial draft this afternoon.
Matt (CEO): Great work.
Elena (CISO): Closing note: please avoid posting raw audit log excerpts in public channels; use the secure evidence bucket and reference ticket numbers.
Devon (eng-security): Noted.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: sync meeting with owners on 1965510000 (UTC).
